title: Grim Fandango Puzzle Document (1996) [pdf]
summary: A vintage 1996 puzzle design document for Grim Fandango, LucasArts' acclaimed point-and-click adventure game featuring Manny Calavera as a travel agent in the Land of the Dead. This PDF represents rare behind-the-scenes insight into classic adventure game puzzle design.
problem_solved: Provides historical documentation of how classic adventure game puzzles were designed and structured in the mid-1990s.
why_valuable: Offers a glimpse into the creative process behind one of gaming's most celebrated adventure titles, serving as both a nostalgia artifact and educational resource for game designers.
